notes: Pages 1-2 are the day-by-day colour-block calendar for 'Mein Abfuhrbezirk: 1 Lechenich, Konradsheim' (title printed at top right of p1); only one district is printed in this PDF so no district choice was needed. Each day has at most one coloured block with a small '1' (collection-round number, not a second date). Legend (bottom of p1/p2): grey=graue Tonne(rest), brown=braune Tonne(bio), blue=blaue Tonne(papier), yellow=gelbe Tonne(gelb), plus a green block labelled 'Weihnachtsbäume' (Christmas-tree pickup on 2026-01-19 only), recorded under 'gruen' per the protocol's Christbaum note. Read from close crops of the März and September columns at 500dpi; every date's printed weekday was checked against the 2026-01-01=Thursday anchor and matched, including the odd grey (rest) pickup on Monday 2026-03-30 that breaks the usual Tuesday rhythm. Page 3 confirms Biotonne is emptied weekly May-November and every 14 days December-April, which matches the weekly Monday bio pattern read for September versus the biweekly Monday pattern read for Jan-Mar. Did not open pages beyond p1-p3 since Jan/Feb/Mar/Sep data is complete from the two calendar pages; a street-cleaning calendar may exist further in the 16-page PDF but was not needed and not opened for bin dates.
